purpose: Present single or multiple disclosure sections with shared primitive semantics and scoped heading navigation.
behaviorProvider: Base UI Accordion disclosure state and ARIA with scoped Aegis focus navigation.

requirements.statement: Use a string for single mode and a string array for multiple mode, normalize both to the primitive array API, and emit an empty string for an empty single selection.
Pass controlled value or defaultValue to Base UI. Hosts using controlled values must apply onValueChange to change the displayed open state.
Cancel a user transition to zero open items when single mode is not collapsible, and mark its open trigger aria-disabled. This does not forbid a host from supplying an empty controlled value.
Forward root and item disabled behavior to Base UI and compose each header with a native trigger button and related disclosure panel.

Handle Home/End and orientation-arrow focus navigation only when the event target is one of this root’s direct natively enabled triggers. Ignore nested triggers even when their perpendicular arrow is unhandled; horizontal arrows follow computed text direction.
Run the supplied root key handler first and do not apply the custom navigation if it prevents default or the event does not originate at a direct trigger.
Supply unique nonempty item values and informative titles. Arbitrary content owns its own interactive names, validation and disabled state.
Preserve important data outside disclosure presentation and implement any fetching or persistence. Opening a panel does not itself validate or save its contents.
Own pattern or component styling consumes surface group tokens. Nested shared components retain their own group ownership; do not restyle their internals.

limitations: No async loading, persistence, item value validation or product-specific navigation policy.
Noncollapsible constrains user transitions, not every controlled value supplied by the host.
Arbitrary nested content is not automatically disabled by disclosure state.
